title: Fix hundreds of missing Oxford commas
body:
While doing #123456 (which this PR is built on) for the meme, I noticed that there are actually a LOT of missing commas in the docs.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Our [writing guidelines](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/guidelines/docs_writing_guidelines.html) for class documentation state to "always [...] use the Oxford comma". This rule is currently broken in hundreds of places across the docs. This PR fixes every instance of a missing Oxford comma that I could find.

## Additional information

I assume that this guideline is up to date and agreed upon in spite of its widespread violation. I searched RocketChat to see if there was any previous discussion of this, but all I could find was a comment from @Mickeon in 2024 which included it in a list of "guidelines that still hold up and have shown to be net positives".

I personally strongly support the use of the Oxford comma in documentation. I think this PR improves the clarity of every sentence it touches.

I proofread the diff twice to make sure I was only adding genuine Oxford commas and not hitting any false positives.

If the maintainers like this PR, I am interested in doing additional PRs to clean up other inconsistently-applied guidelines. (For example, "however" is supposed to be a banned word but currently appears 169 times in the class docs.)


## Changes that aren't strictly comma additions

While making this PR I noticed a few small issues with the docs that are not strictly missing commas, but which occur around missing commas. I decided to fix these with this PR, but I can remove them if it's better to limit the scope of this PR to only added commas.

The affected files are:

* `ShaderMaterial.xml`
* `SystemFont.xml`
